axial_qualification.centre_effect: a purely MULTIPLICATIVE factor sqrt(1+rho); the remainder is not a translation and no additive centre enlargement is applied
axial_qualification.exact_geometry_effect: G = max_i |log(1+lambda_i) - mean_j log(1+lambda_j)|; sup over the set is (d-1)/d log((1+rho)/(1-rho))
axial_qualification.exact_scale_effect: b* = log d - log tr((I+E)^{-1}); sup over the set is -log(1-rho)
axial_qualification.first_order_surrogates_removed: |tr E|/d and ||E - (tr E/d) I||_op both pass the audit's counterexamples where the exact effects fail
axial_qualification.qualified_object: a certified SET E in {||E||_op <= rho}, not one evaluated witness
axial_qualification.rate_effect: factor 1+rho on every relaxation rate, hence on the exposure fraction, the bandwidth product and the localisation ratio
axial_qualification.set_construction: closed-form bound on the exact second-order Schur remainder over the declared primitive covariance, at 3.0 sigma; every step is an inequality

baseline_sign_defect: STILL OWED before W-stage authority freeze; not repaired here

calibration_covariance.bounded_bias: separate structure; never converted into covariance; a missing bound is MISSING, not 0.0
calibration_covariance.conditional_plus_calibration: Var_total = Var_cond + Var_cal, summed once in e1a_v5.calibration.combined_standard_error; the two sources share no primitive, so the declared model carries no cross term
calibration_covariance.contrasts: C_d = D C_b D^T, read off the SAME joint matrix; no independent recomputation
calibration_covariance.differencing_step: each primitive is stepped by its OWN declared standard uncertainty, so the step carries that primitive's units
calibration_covariance.equivalence_demonstration: option B (central differences of the fully profiled pseudo-true parameter) agrees with option A at every entry within both methods' certified enclosures
calibration_covariance.expected_likelihood: closed form via a discrete Lyapunov solve, including the innovation MEAN term so the centre nuisance is identified; no trajectory generated
calibration_covariance.forbidden_shortcut: the ideal Gaussian trace formula is NOT used as the production sensitivity
calibration_covariance.joint_matrix: C_b,cal = J_beta C_phi J_beta^T over all eight log-beta endpoints
calibration_covariance.log_beta_extraction: one row, taken only AFTER the full nuisance system is solved
calibration_covariance.perturbation_side: phi moves the ANALYSIS side (H_A and the observation calibration) with the truth held fixed, which is what a calibration measurement error physically is; V3 perturbed the truth instead and so reported the opposite sign
calibration_covariance.sensitivity_method: U.20 option A: implicit differentiation of the expected-score system, d theta*/d phi = -(d_theta E s)^{-1} d_phi E s
calibration_covariance.shared_primitive_rule: one variable identity per shared standard; off-diagonal blocks follow with no independence assumption

case_contract.mode: any difference fails the deterministic suite; there is no warning-only mode and no registry-as-source-of-truth fallback

numerical_error_certification.floating_point: every hyper-dual component is an interval, outward rounded after each operation (one ulp for the IEEE-correctly-rounded + - * / and sqrt, two for log and exp, which the platform libm does not guarantee)
numerical_error_certification.linear_solve: residual enclosed in interval arithmetic, amplified by a Weyl-certified lower bound on the smallest eigenvalue of the symmetric expected information
numerical_error_certification.method: interval-arithmetic hyper-dual differentiation of the expected-score system
numerical_error_certification.qualification_rule: PASS iff u+ <= c; FAIL iff u- > c; UNRESOLVED otherwise, with inclusive ceiling semantics and c never widened
numerical_error_certification.removed: the V4 fine/coarse agreement plus nine-point least-squares smoothness residual, which bounded neither truncation nor an unobserved higher derivative
numerical_error_certification.riccati_fixed_point: one-step residual divided by 1 - ||F_cl||^2, the contraction factor of the Riccati map
numerical_error_certification.truncation_error: EXACTLY ZERO: the chain rule is evaluated, not approximated; there is no step size
